**What you asked** (the exact command or message)


**What it was pointed at**

A repo, a file, a screenshot, or only a description? If you can share the input, paste or link it. Fictional stand-ins are fine.

**What was wrong with it**

Pick the closest: hedged instead of deciding / generic, could apply to anything / did not read the actual thing / more than three findings / no rewrite at the end / quoted something unsourced / said something about the person / plain wrong, and here is why.
